---
title: "Batch Effect & Integration"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- "data"
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)

batch_step <- find_step(manifest, "batch_check")
batch_summary <- if (!is.null(batch_step)) read_step_summary(result_dir, batch_step$summary) else NULL

integration_step <- find_step(manifest, "integration")
integration_summary <- if (!is.null(integration_step)) read_step_summary(result_dir, integration_step$summary) else NULL
```

## Batch Check

```{r batch-status}
if (is.null(batch_summary)) {
  cat("Batch check summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", batch_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Timestamp: ", batch_summary$timestamp))
}
```

```{r batch-plots, fig.cap="Pre-integration batch check UMAP/tSNE", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(batch_summary)) {
  img_path <- find_artifact(batch_summary, "png")
  if (!is.null(img_path)) {
    display_image(result_dir, img_path)
  } else {
    cat("No batch check plot found.")
  }
}
```

## Integration

```{r integration-status}
if (is.null(integration_summary)) {
  cat("Integration summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", integration_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Method: ", integration_summary$metrics$integration_method %||% "N/A"))
}
```

```{r integration-plots, fig.cap="Post-integration UMAP and clustering tree", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(integration_summary)) {
  img_path <- find_artifact(integration_summary, "png")
  if (!is.null(img_path)) {
    display_image(result_dir, img_path)
  } else {
    cat("No integration plot found.")
  }
}
```
